issues.location: skills/silver-deep-research-multi-ai/scripts/vendor_identity.py:21 (_URL) and :121-129 (_url_vendors), used by signals() and url_slug()
issues.problem: The pack-URL signal, now the only text signal that credits an ambiguous vendor, matches any domain-shaped substring. It has no left boundary (underscore, '?', '#', '=' and '@' are all allowed before it), no right boundary (an '@' or '(' may follow), it runs on lower-cased text, and it needs no scheme, www. or path. So file names, method calls, email local parts and query or fragment values credit ambiguous vendors, Devin among them, and they tick feature cells.

issues.location: vendor_identity.distinctive_tokens rule (c), audit fixture entry autogen
